title: Right work-tape symbols in assembled configuration
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, and form a clock configuration from any clock state, any configuration $c$ of $W$, buffer-tape content and head position, fixed contents and head positions for the $K$ work tapes, and output word. For every work-tape index of $W$, the symbol scanned on the corresponding right-block tape of the clock configuration equals the symbol scanned on that tape in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: fixed contents function for the $K$ work tapes
fixed head-position function for the $K$ work tapes
